claims.statement: Oversmoothing can blur clique members and nearby nonmembers for score-based decoding.
Attention mixes multiscale band-pass scattering and low-pass filters with readouts across layers.
Unsupervised edge/nonedge quadratic loss and greedy multistart decoding construct feasible cliques.
The selected loss explicitly does not satisfy the Erdos Goes Neural probability corollary.
LARGE scores normalize to a short-budget Gurobi incumbent, allowing values above one without exceeding a true optimum.
TWITTER score0.952 is below accurate RUN-CSP0.987; longer-budget Gurobi/heuristics also beat several settings.
The checklist discloses no compute amount/hardware; decoder parameters and model sizes differ by dataset.
